data.evidence: The 2021 result was materially impacted by losses from the 2020 underwriting year. The key drivers of these losses in the year, included winter storm Uri (£12.9 million), hurricane Ida (£1.8 million), Measat (£0.4 million) and adverse development on 2020 losses, including covid losses (£8.2 million) and the Iowa derecho (£2.3 million).
